# One sample lexeme per perly.y terminal the referee sentences use (spec section 8), joined by spaces to render a sentence.
# GRAMPROG is a start selector, not a token, and renders to nothing. A terminal absent here has no single-lexeme
# rendering; every sentence holding one is on nonroundtrip-reviewed.txt. Those at 94e50866:
#   PLUGIN_*    waits for a library operator in scope (the plugin issue removes the entries when it renders them)
#   NCRELOP     is isa, a word until the isa feature is on
#   POSTJOIN    exists only inside an interpolated string, where the lexer makes one token
#   PERLY_DOLLAR  merges with the word after it into one variable token
QWLIST	qw(a)
PERLY_SEMICOLON	;
CHRELOP	<
CHEQOP	==
NCEQOP	<=>
SHIFTOP	>>
POWOP	**
MULOP	*
PERLY_QUESTION_MARK	?
PERLY_COLON	:
OROR	||
MATCHOP	=~
DOTDOT	..
DORDOR	//
BITOROP	|
BITANDOP	&
ASSIGNOP	=
ANDAND	&&
ADDOP	+
REFGEN	\
NOTOP	not
POSTINC	++
POSTDEC	--
METHCALL0	meth
ARROW	->
PERLY_COMMA	,
UNIOP	ref
PREINC	++
PREDEC	--
PERLY_TILDE	~
PERLY_PLUS	+
PERLY_MINUS	-
PERLY_EXCLAMATION_MARK	!
LOOPEX	last
KW_REQUIRE	require
KW_MY	my
KW_LOCAL	local
KW_DO	do
OROP	or
ANDOP	and
LSTOP	print
BAREWORD	foo
PERLY_BRACKET_OPEN	[
PERLY_BRACKET_CLOSE	]
PERLY_BRACE_OPEN	{
PERLY_BRACE_CLOSE	}
UNIOPSUB	foo
BLKLSTOP	any
